movie.title: Arrival
movie.overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.

facts: Did you know the movie's title isn't always just 'Arrival'? The text suggests it can also be referred to as 'Arrivals' or even 'The Arrival(s)'!
When alien crafts land globally, the military makes a unique move: they recruit an expert linguist! It highlights a fascinating approach to first contact.
The entire high-stakes mission for the linguist is to figure out one crucial question: are these aliens here in peace, or do they pose a serious threat?
